title: Hamburg - VfB Stuttgart | 2022/23 Season | Bundesliga
content: Stuttgart could become the first team two win both legs in the promotion/relegation play-off since Wolfsburg did so in 2018 against Kiel.

title: How does promotion and relegation work in the Bundesliga?
content: The first leg at the home of the Bundesliga club ([Wolfsburg](https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/clubs/vfl-wolfsburg)) was played on Thursday 21 May. The return fixture at the Bundesliga 2 club ([Paderborn](https://www.bundesliga.com/en/2bundesliga/clubs/sc-paderborn-07)) was played on Monday 25 May. These dates could have been moved if one or both of the clubs were to be in the DFB Cup final (23 May) or a European final. 2018/19: VfB Stuttgart\* 2-2 **Union Berlin** (2-2, 0-0 – [Union won on away goals](https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/union-berlin-vfb-stuttgart-live-play-off-second-leg-line-ups-stats-mario-gomez-4796)). 2019/20: **Werder Bremen**\* 2-2 Heidenheim (0-0, 2-2 – [Bremen won on away goals](https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/heidenheim-werder-bremen-live-line-ups-stats-relegation-play-off-pizarro-sargent-11901)). 2020/21: [**Cologne**\* 5-2 Holstein Kiel](https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/holstein-kiel-cologne-relegation-play-off-live-line-ups-stats-bartels-meyer-16008) (0-1, 1-5). 2021/22: [**Hertha Berlin**\* 2-1 Hamburg](https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/hamburg-hertha-berlin-relegation-play-off-live-team-news-stats-boateng-glatzel-20044) (0-1, 0-2). 2022/23: [**VfB Stuttgart**\* 6-1 Hamburg](https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/vfb-stuttgart-hamburg-promotion-relegation-play-off-23635) (3-0, 1-3). 2023/24: [**Bochum\*** 3-3 Fortuna Düsseldorf](https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/news/bochum-fortuna-dusseldorf-relegation-play-off-free-highlights-live-blog-27447) (0-3, 0-3 - Bochum won 6-5 on penalties). 2024/25: [**Heidenheim\*** 4-3 Elversberg](https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/matchday/2024-2025/relegation/sv-elversberg-vs-1-fc-heidenheim-1846/liveticker) (2-2, 1-2). 2025/26: [Wolfsburg\* 1-2 **Paderborn**](https://www.bundesliga.com/en/bundesliga/matchday/2025-2026/relegation/sc-paderborn-07-vs-vfl-wolfsburg/liveticker) (0-0, 2-1 a.e.t.). 2022/23: [Arminia Bielefeld 1-6 **Wehen Wiesbaden**\*](https://www.bundesliga.com/en/2bundesliga/news/arminia-bielefeld-wehen-wiesbaden-promotion-relegation-play-off-second-third-division-23637) (4-0, 1-2). 2024/25: [**Eintracht Braunschweig** 4-2 Saarbrücken\*](https://www.bundesliga.com/en/2bundesliga/matchday/2024-2025/relegation/eintracht-braunschweig-vs-1-fc-saarbruecken/liveticker) (0-2, 2-2 a.e.t.). 2025/26: [**Greuther Fürth** 2-1 Rot-Weiss Essen\* (0-1, 2-0)](https://www.bundesliga.com/en/2bundesliga/matchday/2025-2026/relegation/spvgg-greuther-fuerth-vs-rot-weiss-essen/liveticker).
